mentions.name: Study Notes App (Rust + GPUI)
mentions.description: This is a note-taking app for studies, built natively with Rust and the GPUI framework rather than as an Electron-based app.
mentions.problem: The author dislikes Electron-based apps, so existing note apps motivated building a native alternative in Rust.
mentions.audience: A note-taking app built for the author's own studies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a note app for my studies, i dont like electron based apps sot I'm building it with rust and gpui.
